Name: Luny's Wizard Furniture Recolor
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHoUQXE.png[/img]﻿
If you would rather have a unique catalog for these items instead of a retexture of existing items, please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27621]Luny's Wizard Furniture Recolor Catalog[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Zexu2K/about-me?gameId=1303]Zexu2K[/url]. They contacted me about creating a catalog version and they were really awesome to work with! They did a great job creating the catalog, so check that out if you're interested!


A simple recolor for Content Patcher, with a config option to choose between walnut or black for the wood color. To select the color you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or edit the config file. The config file will be created when you launch the game with this mod installed. The options are "Walnut" or "Black".

I plan to add an AT version at a later time, it's just going to take a while to separate all the images and make the jsons.


Other mods shown in the images (that I can remember):

[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23925]Luny's Farm Dresses for FS[/url] (Shawl is currently a work in progress)
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25195]Luny's Witch Hats for FS
[/url]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/lTKkn3N.png[/img]﻿


[left]To install:
Download the file, and unzip the contents.
Move the folder "[CP] Luny's Wizard Furniture Recolor" to your StardewValley/mods folder.
All done! Select your recolor preference using the config file after launching the game once, or by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.
[/left]
If you'd like to support my mods, [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]consider buying me a coffee[/url]. Don't feel obligated though. (￣▽￣*)ゞ I'm also hoping to accept commissions there in the future!
